facts.claim: Overseas markets make up 75% of AGE20'S sales. Japan is the main growth market, and the brand is expanding into the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, Russia/CIS and the Middle East.
The AGE20'S rebrand makes women aged 28–34 its new core target. The first new product is the semi-matte 'Skin First Hidden Prep Foundation Pact'.
The parent group's cosmetics business was 32% of total sales last year, and the stated goal is more than 50% by 2028. AGE20'S has also expanded its US shade range to 20 shades.
AGE20'S reported cumulative global sales of more than 240 million units across 30 countries. The 'Global No.1 pact' wording comes from the brand and is not backed by any official ranking.
AGE20'S says it ranked 1st overall at a large Qoo10 Japan sale event. The source gives no sales figure or event date.
AGE20'S is running IVE Rei out-of-home (OOH) ads in Seoul's Gangnam, Seongsu and Hongdae districts and in subway stations, following the Seongsu pop-up 'THE AGE20'S HOUSE' that opened 2026-10-01.

HERA launched its 'Still Glowing' global Reflection campaign with global ambassador Felix (Stray Kids) on 2026-09-28. In Japan, the new Reflection Skin Glow Powder (8g, shades 01 Glow and 02 Lavender Glow) sells for ¥5,500 including tax.
A limited Reflection Still Glowing set in Japan (foundation 30g + powder + UV tone-up + base) is priced at ¥12,980 including tax. A Korean won price was not found in the sources checked.

JW Pharmaceutical's Friends eye drops have been No.1 in Korea's OTC artificial-tears market for 13 straight years (IQVIA data). aespa was named the new model for Friends eye drops and the iSsuk eyelid cleaner, with the campaign starting 2026-10-20.
The Friends 순/쿨/쿨하이 drops were repackaged under a new integrated identity and now contain hyaluronic acid as an additive. The 아이스 variant moves to the new packaging in stages from mid-October.
The most recent published market-share figure for Friends is 25% of the OTC artificial-tears market. It dates from 2019 and is outdated, and no 2025 share was published.

Fusen Bio says CELLAB Biogenic Essence passed ₩200bn in cumulative sales of a single product. Going from ₩100bn to ₩200bn took 14 months, and the sales came mainly through its own online mall (D2C), without Olive Young or Daiso distribution.
CELLAB released a new TV commercial (TVC) and campaign with actress Jeon Do-yeon pushing its '초기초' (pre-basic step) message and the line '처음이 뛰어남을 만든다'. The earlier campaign featured Kim Hye-ja.

Microbiome derma brand EIOM (Newselect) named Doh Kyung-soo (D.O.) as its model on 2026-10-15. Marketing centers on the Trouble Biome Patch Mask. The previous model, Choi Ye-na, ran the 'Patch Me' campaign, and the product was picked for Olive Young's June '올영픽' promotion.

Shion Lee (션리) followed its model signing of fromis_9's Baek Ji-heon by exhibiting at the 2026 K-Beauty Expo Korea, held at KINTEX for three days from 2026-10-15. Shion Lee's attendance was not confirmed in search.

angles: K-pop model casting is now funding non-cosmetics 'beauty-adjacent' categories: OTC eye drops (JW Friends with aespa) and patch masks (EIOM with D.O.). Practitioners should benchmark against pharmacy-channel brands, not only color cosmetics, when bidding for idol models.

Domestic campaign with a global P&L: AGE20'S gets 75% of sales overseas yet is spending on Seoul OOH. Seongsu/Hongdae OOH works as content for tourists and social feeds that reaches Japan/Qoo10 buyers. Measure it by inbound-tourist sell-through and Japanese social reach, not domestic recall.

Same campaign, different markets: HERA's Felix 'Still Glowing' powder went to Japan first (¥5,500, Sep 28) with Japan-only set bundles and pouches. Brands should plan ambassador campaigns with launch sequencing and price architecture tailored to each market.

Older-actor 'trust' models in D2C skincare: CELLAB moved from Kim Hye-ja to Jeon Do-yeon and built ₩200bn on its own mall without Olive Young. Brands with a single hero product should treat model choice as a lever for customer acquisition cost (CAC) and repeat purchases, not just awareness.

content.title_ko: 해외 매출 75% 브랜드가 성수에 광고를 거는 이유는? 2026년 10월 뷰티 모델·광고 트렌드
content.excerpt_ko: 에이지투웨니스는 매출의 75%가 해외에서 나오는데, 광고는 서울 OOH에 걸었습니다. 헤라는 펠릭스 캠페인 파우더를 일본에서 ¥5,500에 냈고, 아이돌 모델 수요는 안약과 패치까지 번졌습니다. 10월 모델·광고판 흐름 4가지를 숫자로 정리했습니다.
content.body_ko_html:
요약: 이제 모델 계약은 '어느 시장 P&L에 붙일지'부터 정합니다

10월 광고판의 공통점은 하나입니다. 모델을 고를 때 인지도보다 어느 시장, 어느 채널 숫자를 움직일지를 먼저 봅니다.

국내 OOH는 해외 매출용 콘텐츠로 씁니다. 글로벌 앰배서더 캠페인은 국가별로 가격과 구성을 따로 짭니다. 아이돌 모델 수요는 OTC·더마 카테고리까지 번졌습니다.

1. 해외 매출 75%인데 광고는 성수·홍대에

머니투데이에 따르면 에이지투웨니스는 매출의 75%가 해외에서 나옵니다(10월 2일 리브랜딩 보도 기준). 주력은 일본이고, 미국·유럽·동남아·러시아/CIS·중동으로 넓히는 중입니다. 코스인코리아 보도로는 2026년 6월까지 30개국에서 누적 2억 4천만 개가 팔렸습니다. 다만 '글로벌 1위 팩트'는 브랜드 자체 표현이고, 공식 랭킹 근거는 없습니다.

그런데 광고는 서울에 걸었습니다. 보도에 따르면 10월 1일 문을 연 성수 팝업 'THE AGE20'S HOUSE'에 이어 IVE 레이 OOH를 강남·성수·홍대와 지하철 역사에 집행 중입니다(소비자가 만드는 신문).

헤럴드경제에 따르면 새 핵심 타깃은 28~34세 여성입니다. 첫 신제품은 세미매트 '스킨 퍼스트 히든 프렙 파운데이션 팩트'입니다. 모그룹은 2025년 32%였던 화장품 매출 비중을 2028년 50% 이상으로 올리는 게 목표이고, 미국 셰이드도 20호까지 늘렸습니다.

성수·홍대 OOH는 외국인 관광객과 SNS 피드를 거쳐 일본 고객에게 닿는 콘텐츠로 보는 게 맞습니다. 성과도 국내 인지도가 아니라 외국인 셀아웃과 일본 SNS 도달로 재야 합니다.

2. 헤라 펠릭스 캠페인, 일본 가격표부터 따로

헤라는 9월 28일 스트레이 키즈 펠릭스와 글로벌 리플렉션 캠페인 'Still Glowing'을 시작했습니다. 아모레퍼시픽 재팬 보도자료를 보면 일본에서 리플렉션 스킨 글로우 파우더(8g, 01 글로우·02 라벤더 글로우)는 세금 포함 ¥5,500입니다. 파운데이션 30g·파우더·UV 톤업·베이스를 묶은 한정 세트는 ¥12,980입니다. 확인한 자료에서 원화 가격은 찾지 못했습니다.

모델은 같아도 시장마다 출시 일정, 세트 구성, 가격 구조를 따로 짭니다. 글로벌 앰배서더를 쓴다면 캠페인 카피보다 국가별 SKU 구성과 가격표를 먼저 확정해야 합니다.

3. 아이돌 모델, 안약·패치까지 확장

메디게이트뉴스에 따르면 JW중외제약은 프렌즈 아이드롭과 아이쓱 아이리드 클렌저 모델로 에스파를 발탁했고, 캠페인은 10월 20일 시작합니다. 프렌즈는 IQVIA 기준 국내 일반의약품 인공눈물 시장에서 13년 연속(2013~2025) 1위입니다. 순·쿨·쿨하이 3종은 통합 패키지로 바꾸면서 첨가제로 히알루론산을 넣었고, 아이스는 10월 중순부터 순차적으로 바꿉니다.

마이크로바이옴 더마 브랜드 이옴(뉴셀렉트)은 10월 15일 도경수를 새 모델로 발표했습니다(위키트리). 주력은 트러블 바이옴 패치 마스크입니다. 이전 모델 최예나와 'Patch Me' 캠페인을 했고, 6월 올영픽에도 선정됐습니다.

아이돌 모델 단가를 놓고 다투는 상대가 색조 브랜드만이 아니게 됐습니다. 약국 채널 브랜드와 더마 브랜드도 같은 모델을 노립니다. 모델 섭외 예산을 짤 때 이쪽 카테고리도 벤치마크에 넣어야 합니다.

4. 올리브영 없이 누적 2,000억, 다음 모델은 전도연

다음뉴스에 따르면 퓨젠바이오는 셀랩 바이오제닉 에센스 단일 제품 누적 매출이 2025년 말 기준 2,000억 원을 넘었다고 밝혔습니다. 1,000억에서 2,000억까지 14개월이 걸렸고, 올리브영·다이소 없이 자사몰 D2C가 중심이었습니다.

보도에 따르면 10월 1일에는 김혜자에 이어 전도연을 내세운 TVC를 공개했습니다. '처음이 뛰어남을 만든다'는 카피로 '초기초' 메시지를 밉니다(지디넷코리아).

히어로 SKU 하나로 자사몰을 키우는 브랜드에게 모델은 인지도 비용이 아닙니다. 신규 고객 획득 비용(CAC)과 재구매를 움직이는 수단입니다.

다음 분기 체크 포인트

  • 국내 OOH·팝업 성과는 외국인 객단가와 일본·동남아 SNS 도달로 측정
  • 글로벌 앰배서더 캠페인은 국가별 출시 일정·세트 구성·가격표를 먼저 확정
  • 아이돌 모델 단가는 OTC·더마 브랜드 집행 사례까지 넣어 비교
  • D2C 브랜드는 모델 교체 전후 CAC·재구매율을 같은 기준으로 기록

출처: 머니투데이, 헤럴드경제, 코스인코리아, 소비자가 만드는 신문, 아모레퍼시픽 재팬(bestcalendar.jp), 메디게이트뉴스, 위키트리, 다음뉴스, 지디넷코리아

content.title_en: 75% of sales abroad, ads in Seongsu: what K-beauty's October model deals tell you
content.excerpt_en: AGE20'S earns 75% of its sales overseas but bought Seoul OOH. HERA priced its Felix campaign powder at ¥5,500 in Japan. Idol models now sell eye drops and patch masks. Four model and ad moves from October 2026, with the numbers behind each.
content.body_en_html:
Bottom line: brands now pick the P&L before they pick the model

October's ad deals share one pattern. Brands decide which market and which channel a model has to move before they look at fame. Seoul OOH is being bought as content for overseas sales. Global ambassador campaigns get market-specific prices and bundles. Idol models are now in demand outside cosmetics.

1. 75% of sales overseas, ads in Seongsu and Hongdae

Money Today reports that overseas markets make up 75% of AGE20'S sales (reported Oct 2 with the rebrand). Japan is the main growth market, and the brand is expanding into the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, Russia/CIS and the Middle East. CosinKorea reports more than 240 million units sold across 30 countries through June 2026. The "Global No.1 pact" wording is the brand's own and is not backed by any official ranking.

Even so, the ads are in Seoul. Reports say IVE's Rei is on OOH in Gangnam, Seongsu, Hongdae and subway stations, after the Seongsu pop-up "THE AGE20'S HOUSE" opened on Oct 1 (Consumer Times). According to the Korea Herald (Herald Economy), the new core target is women aged 28–34, and the first launch is the semi-matte Skin First Hidden Prep Foundation Pact. The parent group's cosmetics business was 32% of sales in FY2025, with a goal of more than 50% by 2028. US shades now go up to 20.

How to read it: tourist districts work as social content that reaches shoppers in Japan. Judge the spend by sell-through to inbound tourists and by social reach in Japan, not by recall at home.

2. HERA x Felix: a Japan-specific price list

HERA started its global "Still Glowing" Reflection campaign with Felix of Stray Kids on Sep 28. According to Amorepacific Japan's press release, the Reflection Skin Glow Powder (8g, 01 Glow and 02 Lavender Glow) sells for ¥5,500 including tax in Japan. A limited set (foundation 30g, powder, UV tone-up and base) sells for ¥12,980. We did not find a Korean won price.

The point for buyers: one global face does not mean one global assortment. Ask for the market-specific bundle and price list, not just the key visual.

3. Idol models move into eye drops and patches

Medigate News reports that JW Pharmaceutical named aespa as the model for Friends eye drops and the iSsuk eyelid cleaner, with the campaign starting Oct 20. Friends has been No.1 in Korea's OTC artificial-tears market for 13 straight years (IQVIA, 2013–2025). Three variants were repackaged and now contain hyaluronic acid as an additive.

Microbiome derma brand EIOM named D.O. as its model on Oct 15, focusing on its Trouble Biome Patch Mask. The mask was an Olive Young "올영픽" pick in June (Wikitree). Pharmacy and derma brands now bid for the same idol models as color cosmetics brands.

4. ₩200bn without Olive Young, and now Jeon Do-yeon

Fusen Bio says CELLAB Biogenic Essence passed ₩200bn in cumulative single-product sales by the end of 2025. Going from ₩100bn to ₩200bn took 14 months, and sales came mainly through its own online mall (D2C), without Olive Young or Daiso (Daum News). Reports say a new TV commercial with actress Jeon Do-yeon launched Oct 1, following earlier work with Kim Hye-ja (ZDNet Korea). For a brand built on one hero product, the model is a lever on customer acquisition cost and repeat purchases.

What to watch next quarter

  • Inbound-tourist sell-through as the KPI for Seoul pop-ups and OOH
  • Market-specific bundles and pricing for global ambassador launches
  • Idol model fees benchmarked against OTC and derma categories

content.linkedin_en:
75% of AGE20'S sales come from overseas, per Money Today (reported Oct 2, 2026). The brand still bought out-of-home ads in Seoul.

Reports say IVE's Rei is on billboards in Gangnam, Seongsu, Hongdae and subway stations, after a Seongsu pop-up opened Oct 1. Read it as content for tourists and social feeds that reaches Japan, its main growth market. Judge it by sell-through to inbound tourists, not by brand recall at home.

Three other October moves from K-beauty model and ad campaigns:
• HERA x Felix "Still Glowing": in Japan the 8g powder is ¥5,500 and a limited set is ¥12,980 (Amorepacific Japan, Sep 28). The face is global, but bundles and prices are set per market.
• Idol models are moving into new categories. aespa now fronts JW's Friends eye drops, No.1 in Korean OTC artificial tears for 13 straight years (IQVIA, 2013–2025). D.O. fronts EIOM's patch mask.
• CELLAB passed ₩200bn in cumulative sales of one essence through end-2025, mostly through its own online store, and reportedly launched a new TV ad with Jeon Do-yeon on Oct 1.

For buyers: ask K-beauty partners for the market-specific bundle and price list, not just the ambassador's key visual.
